description: This source file contains a PHPUnit test class 'DestroyPurgeStrategyTest' which tests the functionality of the 'DestroyPurgeStrategy' class in the context of the OrangeHRM system. It sets up the test environment, initializes the strategy, and verifies that the 'purge' method correctly deletes associated 'EmpPicture' records from the database.
